blocks.value: A Demat Account stores your shares, but a Trading Account helps you buy and sell them.

Imagine This: A shopping cart helps you purchase products online, while your cupboard stores them after delivery. Similarly, a Trading Account is used to place orders, while a Demat Account stores your shares.
Whenever you click the Buy or Sell button in apps like Zerodha or Groww, you are using your Trading Account.
The Trading Account sends your order to the stock exchange. After the purchase is completed, the shares move into your Demat Account.
Trading Account = Buying & Selling. Demat Account = Storing.
